title: Cake or Cupcake, Chocolate with Chocolate Icing

content.title: About
content.content: The cake or cupcake made from mix 2629 is a chocolate dessert topped with a rich chocolate icing. The mix contains flour, sugar, cocoa, leavening agents and flavorings, and after baking the product is covered with a chocolate glaze that gives a deep, sweet taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Mix 2629 is designed for quick preparation: just add eggs, milk and butter.
The chocolate icing is made from cocoa butter, sugar and butter, creating a glossy finish.
Cake and cupcake from the same mix differ only in pan shape and baking time.
The product is widely used in cafés and bakeries for fast dessert service.
The dry mix has a long shelf life thanks to its low moisture content.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Carbohydrates and sugar provide a quick boost of energy.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa is rich in flavonoids that may support heart health.

items.title: Calcium from dairy ingredients
items.content: Milk and butter added during preparation increase calcium content for bone health.

items.title: Protein
items.content: Eggs added during baking supply high‑quality protein.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The mix provides small amounts of B1, B2 and niacin, which are important for metabolism.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Excessive consumption can contribute to weight gain and raise blood glucose levels.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The icing contains milk and butter, which may trigger reactions in people with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Preparation requires eggs, a common allergen.

items.title: Caffeine and theobromine
items.content: Cocoa contains small amounts of caffeine and theobromine, which can affect sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Bake the cake or cupcake according to the package directions, then drizzle with chocolate icing. Serve warm or chilled, optionally garnish with berries, nuts or a dusting of powdered sugar.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the finished dessert in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days or in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. Keep the dry mix in a cool, dry place, tightly sealed.
